name: Gravel V3 RS / Sensah 2×12

editorial.verdict: Cheapest traceable carbon complete; the obvious choice when purchase price matters most.
strengths: Full carbon frame/fork/cockpit package at an unusually low complete-bike price
caveats: Maximum clearance is not clearly published
Frame-molding provenance and model-specific testing are not transparent
Exact component substitutions must be checked

purchase_route: Current official factory-store page identifies the exact RS 24-speed configuration and exposes direct inquiry/order routing; Shenzhen manufacturer contact is also published. Confirm current mainland stock, warranty, shipping and selected-option checkout before paying.
claimed_complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer 25yr T47 RS-24S hydraulic alloy-wheel configuration; size and pedal basis unstated. The storefront 9.6 kg claim describes a BB86 listing and is not assigned to this T47 build.
